name: evaluation-fair-rivals
cmd: set -e; for s in 1 2; do for sc in 10 40; do for st in '' _late; do {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s${s}_sc${sc}${st} --ref-cache {cache}/desk_tempho_1995_s${s}${st} --out {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s${s}_sc${sc}${st} --incremental --n-pos 96 --pos-seeds 1 2 3 4 5 --tag _p96; done; done; done
summarize: for s in 1 2; do for sc in 10 40; do for st in '' _late; do {python} research/exp/fair_rivals.py --summarize {out}/desk_tempho_1995_s${s}_sc${sc}${st} | grep -E 'TREATMENT|features x|^desk_tempho'; done; done; done
note: E043 amendment: over-sampled models vs same-seed controls on E039h's estimand -- raw change, within readout, and the gain beyond the adequate (96x5) trend placebo, paired
